rows.59:068c:
I'm Tomoharu Hosoda, a second-year.
You're {a}, right?
Before we start, I have a favor to ask.
I'd like you to keep my name out of the article.
If you can't promise me that, I can't tell this story.
Okay?{p}Will you keep me anonymous?
rows.59:0768: Secretly name him in the article
rows.59:07d8:
Has anyone here ever explored the forbidden space in our school?
...Looks like nobody's raising a hand.
Well, I guess that's only natural.
That place is really bad news.
Huh? Which place am I talking about?
That would be……………………………………a toilet.
And not just any toilet.{p}
rows.59:08f4: It's the toilet that won't flush.{p}
rows.59:0928:
Well...?
Just hearing that, you can imagine how terrifying this toilet is.
You rush into a stall in a hurry.
And then, once you've finished your business, the toilet won't flush...
That kind of panic is like nothing else, right?
It must feel exactly like seeing heaven and hell all at once.{p}
rows.59:0adc:
That restroom is pretty famous, you know.
It's claimed a lot of victims in the past.
Most people who go in there end up feeling sick and get sent to the nurse's office.
After a while, once they're feeling better, they have to clean the toilet that won't flush themselves.
Why does everyone who uses that toilet get sick?
At first, I figured they felt sick from panicking when the toilet wouldn't flush.
But the reason wasn't that simple.{p}
rows.59:0c70:
This was just the other day.
Hino came to me with his plan for this seven wonders meeting.
He said he wanted me to present that report on the forbidden restroom he'd been asking me for.
Honestly, I wasn't too keen on it.
A terrifying, unnatural aura always hung around that restroom.{p}
rows.59:0d88:
Well, there are lots of ghost stories about restrooms, and plenty of restrooms have an aura.
But for some reason, that was the one restroom I didn't want to go to.
An aura that keeps you away... I guess you could call it that.
I could feel it so strongly it hurt.
But it was Hino asking, of all people.
So I decided to explore the forbidden restroom.
Of course, before I went there, I made sure to do my business in a different restroom.
I didn't want to become a victim of the toilet that won't flush.{p}
rows.59:0f4c:
And so, one day after school, I went to the toilet that won't flush.
It was filled with an overwhelming aura.
First, I peeked into the stalls one by one.
One of the toilets was giving off an especially strong aura.{p}
rows.59:100c:
...I was sure that bowl was the toilet that won't flush.
I searched the stall all over, but there was nothing especially suspicious.
I could feel an overwhelming aura, but I couldn't tell where it was coming from.
So I decided to try squatting down over the toilet for a bit.
...Sorry, it's a weird thing to talk about.
Suddenly, I felt an overwhelming aura behind me.
It felt like someone was staring right at me.{p}
rows.59:1180:
"Who's there?"
I muttered it without thinking, but nobody answered me.{p}
rows.59:11e0:
I stayed there with my head down for a while, feeling that aura.
...I see. So this is how everyone ended up feeling sick.
That's what I thought right away.
Even so, an aura that strong, and I couldn't see anything?
I couldn't believe it.
Just then, I suddenly heard a voice from behind me.
"Wrong..."
What was wrong?{p}
rows.59:1320:
I turned around one more time.
But sure enough, there was nobody there.
"You can't see me, can you?
...Nobody can."
I heard a sad voice.
"And when I touch people, nobody notices.
It's the same with you, right?
...See, I'm touching your shoulder right now.
You can't tell, can you?"{p}
rows.59:145c:
A chilly sensation spread across my shoulder.
"I-I can tell..."
That's what I answered.
So there really was a ghost in the forbidden toilet that won't flush.
I decided to find out more about this ghost.
"This aura hanging in the restroom is yours, isn't it?
Why are you giving off such a powerful aura?"
"...I can't leave this place.
More importantly, I have to find that guy."
"What guy?"
"I don't even know his name.
I don't know his face, either.
But I have to find him..."
"Then how are you supposed to find him?"{p}
rows.59:164c:
"I have to find him..."
After saying that, the voice went silent.{p}
rows.59:16ac:
The next day after school, I reported to Hino.
I told him there was the ghost of a man in the forbidden restroom.
"That's amazing, Hosoda.
You've got to find out who that man really is.
Man, I knew you'd pull it off."
"Yes, I'm heading to that restroom again today."
Hino looked really pleased.
With that much riding on me, there was no backing out now, right?{p}
rows.59:1804:
Besides, the ghost in the forbidden restroom sounded so lonely.
I thought maybe I wouldn't mind being his friend.
I mean, he didn't seem like a bad guy.{p}{a}, do you think that's strange?
rows.59:18f0:
...Thank you.
I think you and I could be good friends, too.{p}
rows.59:1940:
I headed for the forbidden restroom.
When I went into that stall, I heard the voice again.{p}
rows.59:19a0:
"Wrong..."
The ghost said the same thing again.
"What exactly is wrong?"
When I asked, he said this:
"You're not the man I'm looking for..."{p}
rows.59:1a48:
"A man? Who are you looking for?"
"......"
"Why are you looking for this man?"
"I don't know. I don't know. I don't know anything..."{p}
rows.59:1b08:
Suddenly, the stall door flew open.
A strong wind blew through the restroom.
My legs gave out from under me.
I couldn't move for a while.{p}
rows.59:1b90:
"I don't know, I don't know, I don't know..."
The ghost said it like it was tearing him apart.
I couldn't bear it.
I wanted so badly to help him.{p}
rows.59:1c2c:
"Hey, isn't it impossible to find someone when you don't know who they are?"
I shouted as hard as I could so the wind wouldn't drown me out.{p}
rows.59:1ca4:
"It's not impossible. I'll never forget the sight of his back..."
That's what he said.{p}
rows.59:1d08:
...So here's what it came down to.
The ghost remembered a certain man from behind.
And he was searching for that man.
Why, even he didn't know.
I promised I'd help him look.{p}
rows.59:1df0:
"...Thank you.
Then from now on, will you watch the backs of the people who come into this restroom, too?"
"Hold on a second.
I don't want to spy on people using the toilet.
Besides, you might not know this, but this place is called the forbidden restroom.
Hardly anyone ever comes here, right?
This is a bad place to look for someone."
"But I can't leave here."
"Why not?"
"I don't know..."{p}
rows.59:1f68:
Why couldn't he leave the restroom?
I wanted to get to the bottom of it.
So I decided to look around a little.
There didn't seem to be anything unusual about the stall.
There was no graffiti on the walls, and there was water in the toilet bowl, the way there should be.{p}
rows.59:2068: ...I stared at the toilet and thought.
rows.59:20b4: Stick my hand in the toilet
rows.59:21f0:
"I remember now.
That's my little sister...☆"
...Something cold touched me around the neck.
He had put his hand there.
It felt eerily real, and I spun around with a start.{p}
rows.59:22ac:
...I could see his spirit body clearly.
Maybe because he'd remembered what it was like when he was alive.
Then a cold wind blew against the nape of my neck.
It seemed to be his breath.
I heard him panting... hah... hah... like he was in pain.
He seemed terribly worked up.{p}
rows.59:23a0:
"I hate... I hate..."
He started saying things like that.
"What do you hate?
Do you hate your sister?"
"I hate... I hate...☆"
The voice got even louder.
His emotions must have been running really high.
He just kept saying "I hate" over and over, and he wouldn't answer me.{p}
rows.59:24b4:
Then the restroom door and windows started to rattle.{p}Spirit rapping, I guess you'd call it.
It was incredibly violent.
rows.59:2560:
I decided to retreat for the time being.
I left the stall right away and went out into the hallway.{p}
rows.59:2640:
The next day, when I went to the forbidden restroom, there was no sign of the ghost.
Where could he have gone?
I searched all kinds of restrooms around the school.
But I couldn't find out where he'd gone.
Then a thought struck me.{p}
rows.59:27f8:
That meant the search area got a lot bigger.
I searched all over the place during breaks and after school.{p}
rows.59:28f4:
When I went into the forbidden restroom, I felt a chill touch me from behind.
...It was him.
"Hosoda, I remember everything now."
His voice was quiet.
"So, I have a favor to ask..."
If he'd still been alive, he would have been drenched in clammy sweat.
That was the feeling he gave off.
"You're the only one I can ask to do something like this."
That's what he said.
And then he told me the whole story.
It was something that happened about two years ago.{p}
rows.59:2b20:
The car that did it was one that drove a student from our school to and from school.
It seems some students got a ride to school by car now and then.
What he saw as he was hit was the back of a student in our uniform, inside the car as it drove away.
Inoue decided he would find out who that student was.{p}

59:21f0/23a0: ☆ kept after the ghost's lines as in source.
